```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Both the Venezuelan government and the Venezuelan opposition bear significant responsibility for the current crisis.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Venezuelan government is increasingly top-down.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Venezuelan opposition has at times resorted to anti-democratic methods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As US socialists, there is a duty to do everything possible to stop US imperialism and make the world safe for democracy and socialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The organization should not intervene in the internal politics of Venezuela.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is a responsibility to use leverage to intervene strategically in US foreign policy to help the Venezuelan people defend the gains made during Hugo Chávez’s presidency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The US government should immediately cease and desist all attempts to intervene in the internal politics of Venezuela.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The US government has a shameful legacy of imperial control in the region.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA chapters and DSA supported political representatives should mobilize around a campaign of solidarity with the Venezuelan people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The campaign of solidarity should aim specifically at reversing the US government’s sanctions against Venezuela.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The US government’s sanctions against Venezuela are disastrous and counterproductive.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
